nodes.question: How do fleet-related measures impact the composition of the vehicle fleet, especially regarding zero-emission vehicles?
nodes.answer: Fleet-related measures directly affect the composition of the vehicle fleet by increasing the share of zero-emission vehicles. This allocation is detailed in the Supplementary Material section C.
